the memset of nr_drb_mapping_t is performed in RLC-BearerConfig so this will not work.
We probably need to create arrays indexed by the DRB identity, with one part for the PDCP-Config and one for the RLC-BearerConfig

I think the confusion is that The same 'mapping' type has been extended to cover 2 entirely different protocol layers, which won't overlap in terms of trees in RRC.

So the MAC/RLC settings (i.e. the first half of nr_drb_mapping_t) are collected under RLC-BearerConfig, and set using set_mac_nr_bearer_mapping().

The RLC/PDCP bearer settings (the 2nd half of nr_drb_mapping_t) are collected under DRB-ToAddMod, and set using set_rlc_nr_drb_pdcp_seqnum_length().

It would make sense to split nr_drb_mapping_t into separate, smaller structs (where only ueid and drbid would be common).

There may be a case for having SRB-ToAddMod as a separate root to collect info + configure, but unless/until I see an example of 'disableCiphering' for an SRB, I don't think its needed.

Does this make sense to you?
